snippet.title: Cook. Fight. Survive. | COOKWORM - Official Release Trailer
snippet.description:
COOKWORM IS OUT NOW! 🔥🪱🍳

🎮 COOKWORM is available NOW on itch.io!

https://cookworm.itch.io/cookworm

A worm chef is trying to save his restaurant...

But there's a small problem.

Alien restaurant owners have sent an army of mutant food to destroy everything.

Fight your way through chaotic worlds, defeat ridiculous enemies, discover powerful weapons, create insane combinations, and turn your defeated enemies into ingredients for your restaurant.

Every run is different.

Every build gets crazier.

And eventually... you might not even be able to see what's happening on screen anymore.

🍳 Fight mutant food
🔫 Discover powerful weapons
💥 Create completely ridiculous builds
📦 Find powerful items and upgrades
👽 Defeat strange bosses
🪱 Cook your enemies and sell them in your restaurant
🔥 Unlock permanent upgrades and become even stronger

COOKWORM is a chaotic 2D action roguelite filled with cartoon violence, absurd weapons, mutant food, aliens, explosions, and way too many things happening at the same time.


You can find the link to play the game on my channel.

Welcome to the weirdest restaurant in the universe.

#Cookworm #IndieGame #Roguelite #ActionGame #GameDev
